page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfg6.8xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine instance running on the KVM hypervisor. It features 32 dedicated vCPUs based on the x86_64 architecture, utilizing Intel Xeon 8269CY processors with a clock speed of 3.1 GHz. The hardware configuration includes 16 physical cores supporting hyper-threading, which provides two threads per core. The instance is equipped with 128.0 GB of RAM, yielding 4.0 GB of memory per core. No local storage or dedicated GPU hardware is bundled with this instance, and it provides a baseline network bandwidth of 10 Gbps.

In benchmark evaluations, the ecs.hfg6.8xlarge demonstrates stable compute and memory performance. The Intel Xeon processor achieves a stress-ng single-core CPU score of 1436.68 and a multi-core score of 30666.35. Memory performance testing shows a read-only small block cached bandwidth of 1705.41 GB/sec, while large block uncached read and write speeds reach 109.89 GB/sec and 48.22 GB/sec, respectively. The system also records 28.91 million operations per second in Redis SET tests and a PassMark database operations score of 11442.59.

This instance is designed for general-purpose workloads, multi-threaded applications, and database operations that require dedicated compute resources. It handles text and image processing tasks, as indicated by Geekbench scores of 1698.0 and 10079.0. Because the instance lacks local storage, deployments must utilize external network-attached storage. The hardware supports smaller machine learning tasks, achieving 85.62 tokens per second for text generation on a 135M parameter model, but it is not configured for larger model inference due to the absence of GPU acceleration.
